## Practical info

- Exam date: Monday 30 November, 8:30--12:30
- The exam will take place in AB 403

What should you bring:

- Student ID
- Pens, pencils, eraser, ...
- A snack (optional)

## Explicitly NOT ALLOWED

Not allowed:

- Cheat sheets and notes
- Calculators
- Electronic devices (phone, smart watch, ...)

*Even having these on you in the exam room will be considered as academic fraud.*

## Grade calculation

| Grade item           | Max score |
|----------------------|:---------:|
| Exam                 |    16     |
| Quizzes              |     3     |
| Practical attendance |     1     |

## How to prepare your answers

- Use your scratch paper to do calculations, figure something out, etc.
- Present your final argument on the answer sheet.

Be very mindful:

- **Show your work!**
- **Leave enough time to finish writing!**

## Special instructions

- Do not write across the margins
- Don't write solutions next to each other on the same page
- Write clearly and cleanly

## What to study

- Re-do problems from theory and practicals
- Do some extra problems
- Use sample exams wisely
  - Time yourself
  - Focus on hard problems

## Asking for help

- Contact your TAs or myself
  - Show your work
  - Early is better than late

## On the day of the exam

At the start:

- Go to the correct room
- Wait outside until called in
- Leave backpacks and coats at the front of the room (switch off your phone)
- Take a seat at the desk with your name on it

At the end (when you are done):

- Hand in all your papers
